description: WHM Jupiter interface customization retrieval and deletion. Retrieval preserves opaque payload data; update serialization remains excluded.

notes.text: Available in cPanel and WHM 100 and later. Deletes customization data for the Jupiter theme only. Server owners and resellers can customize their users interface. application is cpanel or webmail. A selective path removes only the selected element using the supported dot-separated JSONPath subset. Deletion changes branding and has no client rollback. The source response declares metadata only, so the typed method returns void. Review 5721307565 (https://github.com/hostingpal/whm-api-client/pull/70#pullrequestreview-5721307565) on cPanel 11.138.0.19 inspected Whostmgr/API/1/Customizations.pm and Whostmgr/Customizations.pm: omitted path, exact empty string and exact string 0 select the whole default customization section. No delete was run.

Client policy: use one form POST without automatic retry or rollback. Typed deletion requires an explicit nonnullable path and rejects trimmed blanks and trimmed zero before HTTP. Whitespace and trimmed-zero rejection are additional conservative policy; accepted paths are forwarded byte-exact without trimming. Missing/null arguments fail before the group callback and retain prior metadata; runner guard failures clear it. Deliberate whole-section deletion remains available through generic call() with form POST; it is irreversible.
